## 维护者速读

一个多包产物在安装时，如果后面的某个包被引擎拒绝，前面已经注册的包会留在运行中的内核里，但没有写进安装记录。门口回答是失败(422)，内核里却已经有了一部分包，重启后又消失。应在拒绝时把同一产物里已注册的包撤回，或者在注册前先整体校验。

## What is wrong (measured by the #31478 dev, inline and cloud branches)

- An artifact registers its packages one by one through `manifest.register`. When a later member is refused, the earlier members stay registered in the running kernel.
- The install answers the refusal (422) and writes no ledger entry. The kernel then serves part of an install that was refused. A restart drops them, because the ledger has none.

## Expected

- A refused install leaves the running kernel as it was. Either the members already registered from the same artifact are withdrawn when one is refused, or the whole artifact is checked before any member registers. The choice is the dev's, argued on the four axes.
- Pins, red on main first: a two-member artifact whose second member is refused leaves neither member registered, on both branches. CONTROL: a single-package refusal is answered as today.

Related: #31478 / PR #31563, #31392.
